reviews.title: Awesome Case!
reviews.comment: Got white and Black ones, about 13 for a client. Love these cases. Not one part missing, nothing broken, everything worked great. Had zero complaints while building in them. They have great air flow and price point is GREAT with the fans included and fan controller. Fans are nice and tie into mobo software or lighting software. Would recommend and will be building computers in the future with Montech cases. Fans were silent when tuned. Nice small-esk mid-tower that look nice in the office with lights turned off or on a nice white. Easy to build in. Let's go Montech! Thanks for doing it right.
reviews.author: RestartFirst

reviews.title: Great-looking case with awesome airflow and lights out of the box
reviews.comment: I recently built a new gaming PC and went with the Montech Sky Two case — and I’m really happy with it. It was my first time buying a Montech product, but after seeing the build quality and features, I’ll definitely consider them again. First off, this thing looks sharp. The dual tempered glass panels on both sides make it easy to show off all your parts — and trust me, it looks really good with RGB lighting inside. The front has a clean, modern look with good ventilation. What sold me was that it comes with 4 ARGB PWM fans already installed. That saved me a bunch of money and time because usually you have to buy fans separately and wire them up yourself. These are bright, colorful, and sync up well with my motherboard via the included controller. Lights look great without being too over the top. Airflow is solid too. With the front and side panels open for intake and the rear exhaust, temps on my GPU and CPU are staying nice and low. I did install an extra fan just for extra cooling, but even before that, things were running smoothly. The Type-C port on the front panel is super convenient. My old case had USB-A only, and now I can plug in my phone or flash drive super fast without having to dig around back. Build quality feels strong — thick metal, sturdy glass panels, and the cable management channels in the back are wide enough to run wires through easily. Took some time to set everything up, but the layout makes it manageable even if you're not a pro builder. Overall, if you want a sleek, high-airflow case with RGB already built in, this is a great pick. Feels like a premium case for a mid-range price.
reviews.author: Shailesh Kalloe

reviews.title: Yeah, this case rocks.
reviews.comment: I decided to go with the Montech Sky Two for my first ever PC build and I am glad I did! The case is large and beautiful. It's able to fit my 3070 Ti and has plenty of room for an even larger card. The front and side glass panels give you an excellent view of the components inside. The pre-installed fans are just the best. They have great lighting effects and airflow. I even bought an extra one to place at the top for extra exhaust. My case and the air flowing out are always pretty cool to the touch when even playing more demanding games like Stalker 2 and Helldivers 2. Not noticeably loud for me either. My home is naturally very dusty, but I think the filters do a good job at keeping most of it out. The cable management was done well and it comes with tons of extra screws and zip ties for all your needs. Sleek design, spacious interior, easy cable management, pre-installed fans... This case checked all the boxes for me and I think you can't go wrong with it.
reviews.author: Linda Samudio

reviews.title: My go to for budget builds without sacrificing aesthetics
reviews.comment: stylish and budget-friendly mid-tower case that offers excellent airflow and build quality. It comes with four pre-installed ARGB fans, supports large GPUs up to 400mm, and features dual tempered glass panels for a sleek look. Cable management is straightforward, making it a great choice for both new and experienced builders. Overall, it’s a solid case that delivers great value for its price.
reviews.author: Gabe

reviews.title: Affordable, but well built!
reviews.comment: Great case and fanatics looking. However the rear fan does not support 240mm aio cooler, but with some engineering I mad it work. Cheap case but well built. The cable management was easy with all the holes and slots to run the cables. It was perfect size to fit under my desk. The fans are honestly a lot quieter then my old Be Quiet! Fans.
reviews.author: Sean
